en.text:
Dealing damage with <void/>Pocket Singularity grants 'Soul Siphon Ready' for 20 seconds, replacing your melee ability with Soul Siphon. 

[Melee Input] while Soul Siphon is readied to tether up to four enemies within 20 meters in front of you, granting 15 HP of <void/>Void Overshield for 15 seconds (23 seconds with <void/>Echo of Persistence) per tick of damage. 

Soul Siphon deals 8 ticks of increasingly higher melee damage over 3.2 seconds and restores ?% Class Ability energy per tick.

At the end of the drain, Soul Siphon triggers a final burst of damage that staggers any surviving combatants.
